description:
Doc's Needless Economic Expansion Pack

Current Version: 0.2.1 "Mann Co" edition!

Due to new rules on ai generated content This mod has been made unavailable until proper replacements can be acquired

Have you ever looked at the economy of Starsector and thought "There are too few commodities." or "I wish commodity bloat was a thing I had to deal with."? Well if so you've come to the right place!

DNEEP, as it's name says, is an economic expansion pack with the goal of providing the game with an expanded economy putting more steps between ore and starship, while also increasing the number of industries and making planets that would be overlooked into worlds that serve as economic centers, hubs of industry, or stepping stones to provide various luxuries and needed commodities that any world would need realistically.

Why you may ask? Well for one the materials used to maintain a starship would be vastly different from the materials used to build a house, even in the far future. The second reason is because I wanted to test myself and see if I could make something of this style.

Works with:

Iron shell
United Auroran federation
Volkov industrial Conglomerate
Hazard mining Incorporated
Machina void shipyards
Hivers
Scalartech

To faction mod devs, If you wish for me to change a condition that appears on your planet or remove compatibility I will do so, just contact me here or on the discord server @ Plague Doctor#1665

For those who aren't faction mod devs feel free to request a faction you wish for me to add compatibility for, but please do DM me about it. I plan on adding compatibility for every faction mod I can, I'm just not aware of all of them.

Changelog:

Spoiler
0.2.1 "Finally works properly."

-the actually right mod file is now available.

0.2.0 "Mann Co"

-added new commodities, duracrete, habitat supplies, building supplies, raw stone
-added new industries, planetary quarry, construction yards, duracrete facilities,
-added unique industry to Nortia called "Kalcos Industries"
-added new demands to population and infrastructure being the new supplies types.
-new graphics for fisheries, brewery, winery, and aquaponics

-various small tweaks

Roadmap

Spoiler
With the new release of DNEEP "Mann Co" I can now move onto working on Titans of industry, which will be the largest(Non-story) Update for DNEEP, which will be including at least 20 new commodities, 15 new industries, 40 new resource conditions, 10 new conditions which effect colonies, several new trade and underworld contacts, and a few new star systems and colonies. So it's going to be a while before that comes out.

Goes well with:

Industrial.Evolution

Grand.Colonies

Ashes of the Domain of Man

To have DNEEP work properly you need to change the industries per planet size to at least be 1 industry per size so for a size six it should have the ability to have 6 industries, if you don't do this planets are liable to deciving due to stability issues.

Known incompatibilities:

Lobster proliferation: the way DNEEP adds new demands to the population and infrastructure industry conflicts and in my testing, overwrites lobster proliferation or caused instability in the game. I am currently looking for a fix to this.

The way DNEEP spawns industries and conditions conflicts with Nexerelin's random core sector, otherwise works fine with Nex.

aiDescription: Introduces a variety of new goods and industrial facilities to bridge the gap between raw resources and finished products. It modifies planetary development so that previously overlooked worlds become vital economic hubs or stepping stones for luxury and essential supplies. The update includes specific changes to population demands and infrastructure requirements to support these new industries.
